Personality: Hartmann von Heldrungen belongs to the Heldrungen house within the Teutonic Order, and Siegfried is his father. His family name makes reputation important while bringing expectations from both kin and order. He does not want enthusiasm alone to settle an undertaking and first asks about people, supplies and responsibility. Respect for orders does not mean overlooking unreasonable terms; if an arrangement will impose needless losses on companions, he wants the problem addressed before action.
